title: Milne's rationality conjecture for abelian varieties

construction_ideas.idea: 把通用非零 minor 的选择与评价点的选择分离：有界次数同时避零。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 固定离散赋值系数域 K1/K0 为有限扩张，r,b≥1；所有禁用多项式属于同一 K1[X0,...,X_{r-1}]，非零、总次数≤b。取 N>b，B=b sum_{i=0}^{r-1}N^i；若 e 为 K1/K0 分歧指数，取素数 q>max(B,e)，theta^q=p，令 Xi=theta^{N^i}。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 不同多重指标以 N 进制映入不同单变量指数，总次数≤b 的非零多项式变为次数≤B 的非零单变量多项式；[K1(theta):K1]=q>B，故共同非零。可同时处理任意基数的固定域约束。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 若存活 row-transversal Q(Z) 对应的若干目标 minors 可先证明是统一次数有界的非零形式，可用幂指数隔离得到一个同时保秩的代数参数点；整系数或有理参数版本可再用根界选择整数 t。它启发先证明形式非零、后计高度的分层设计。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 原引理提供的是高次数代数点，不是低高度整数点。要用于 pi 的整数 determinant 矛盾，必须另给 norm/分母清除与高度成本；指数 N^i 可能令 column-cost 失控。若系数域随 theta 扩张则结论不成立。

construction_ideas.idea: 以总缺陷的超模性寻找唯一最大的障碍，避免逐个子对象检验。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 子对象格对交与和封闭；f(P)=t_H(P)-t_N(P) 只取有限多个值，Newton 数在短正合列可加，Hodge 交维数满足 f(P)+f(Q)≤f(P∩Q)+f(P+Q)；给定可逆算子保持滤过及 f。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 所有最大值对象在交与和下封闭，因此存在唯一包含全部最大值对象的最大 Pmax；保持 f 的算子必固定 Pmax。只需在算子稳定子对象上排除正缺陷。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 在有限行/列支持集合上，若把容量缺陷写为 modular capacity 减 matroid rank，则超模性给一个 canonical 最大坏集合。可尝试用它压缩 signature capacities 的所有 Hall 型障碍，并检验实际 Q(Z) 存活条件是否容许相同闭包。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 当前 row-transversal 家族未必构成对交/并封闭的格；加入二次 occupancy 代价后必须重新证明所用缺陷的超模方向，不能只沿用线性 rank 的直觉。

construction_ideas.idea: 用一个固定有理配对归一化全部局部对象，始终比较同一个对象。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 各实现中 a*theta_B=lambda_v theta_*；theta_* 为同一有理 ample 除子，deg(theta_*^D)≠0，a*theta_B 也为有理除子，cycle trace 与有理交数相容。
construction_ideas.mechanism: lambda_v=deg(a*theta_B theta_*^{D-1})/deg(theta_*^D) 为同一个有理 lambda；再由 untwisted tensor 恢复 twisted 类的共同缩放。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 整数 determinant 构造若经历基变换、投影、不同范数或不同局部实现，应先固定同一 rational normalization/清分母因子。可用一个非零有理测试功能校准，防止算术下界与解析上界实际作用于不同缩放的 determinants。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 这里只是精确相容性的设计原则；pi 近似问题仍需真实非零 determinant 及定量共同分母估计。

construction_ideas.idea: 用向量值多项式的系数而非单个 eigenspace 的有理下降生成目标空间。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: E/Q 有限 CM 域；T 为 E-秩 2s 的 rational summand；D=sum_tau D_tau 在每个 eigenspace 非退化；全部 (b*D)^s（b∈E）位于一个共同有理 divisor span。
construction_ideas.mechanism: P(x)=(sum_tau x_tau^2 D_tau)^s 的 x_tau^{2s} 系数为非零 determinant D_tau^s；对 rational points 的 Zariski 稠密性及 faithful scalar extension 给整个有理 pure determinant 空间的包含。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 若可把多个近似线性形式编码成有理向量值多项式，可通过系数提取/有限差分隔离一个特定 transversal 或 signature，而不要求每个嵌入/坐标单独有理。
construction_ideas.missing_step: Zariski 稠密只给存在；用于整数 determinants 需显式有限评价集、Vandermonde 分母及评价高度，且不能假定 isolated coefficient 自动没有 cancellation。

title: The rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties

construction_ideas.idea: 相同 signature/marginal capacities 之间用局部 two-row switches 建立连通性。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 两张 p×m 的 ±1 表每列 plus-sign 个数相同；行可扩成 odd sign functions，conjugate columns 取反。每次只交换同一列中两行相反的 entries，并在 conjugate column 交换相反 entries。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 逐列把 (+,−) 与 (−,+) mismatches 配对，每步保总 column sums，得到有限路径；每步只需四-label relation a+b=a'+b'。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 对于 surviving transversal Q(Z)，可把同一 signature 的 row assignment 视为固定 marginals 的 fiber。若 admissible assignments 在允许的 swaps 下连通，可由一个 explicit seed determinant 扩展到整个 signature class，或用局部交换说明各 occupancy profile 的最优 column-cost。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 原文是在所有 odd sign functions 的扩大辅助空间中连通；加入禁止边、固定实际行池、rank 约束、quadratic occupancy 后 fiber 可能断开。必须证明每步仍有存活 transversal，并跟踪 determinant 的符号/非零性与高度。

construction_ideas.idea: 使用非零 dual contraction 组合局部证书，保留精确 scalar 与 slot bookkeeping。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 中间每个 slot 有 opposite embedding lines beta_i、gamma_i，二者互为非零 conjugate scalar multiples；ample polarization ell_i 使 qi=∫ beta_i∧gamma_i∧ell_i^{s−1}≠0。前后 tensors 是各槽纯张量、且已为 algebraic-coefficient cycle spans。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 在 triple product 上 pullback、cup product、乘 polarization 幂再 pushforward，输出 endpoint pure tensor 乘 (−1)^{p(p−1)/2} product qi；codimension 逐项核对，qi∈Qbar× 可以除掉。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 若把 row/column block determinants 的外幂证书作为端点，以一个 nondegenerate rational dual pairing 消去辅助 slots，可像 Cauchy–Binet 那样组合局部 rank 证书。明确乘积 scalar 可帮助避免把非零 functional 误当作非零 determinant vector。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 一般 determinant 展开含多项会 cancellation；原文 pure tensor 与 polarization positivity 很强。迁移时需自行找到 rational dual bases、明确 pairing 非零，并把 division 导致的 denominator/height 计入算术下界。

construction_ideas.idea: 固定总解析对象，在分解之间连续移动以保非零，最后才分解与清分母。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 总 rational Hermitian plane W、symplectic representation、finite theta input phi、compact quotient X 全固定；仅 compact-place positive Lagrangians 在固定 sign multiplicities 内变化；theta series 在紧参数邻域及所有需用导数有统一 Gaussian 控制。
construction_ideas.mechanism: rank-two total form Xi(phi;t) 在同一 compact X 上 C∞ 连续；初始 ∫xi∧bar(xi)>0，因此足够接近的 rational endpoint t' 仍有非零 mixed pairing。两端才改 rational adapted coordinates 并有限分解为 wedges，再共用 cover。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 对 parameterized matrix/determinant D(t)，先固定总函数与解析上界，找一个确定非零 seed，再以连续性选择 rational perturbation；最后以 explicit denominator 把同一个 D(t') 变为整数 determinant。可用于设计 rank-preserving signature switches。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 连续性无显式 tolerance 或 rational height bound；本稿允许 rational approximation 的分母任意大，这在 pi 的算术-解析指数竞争中不能忽略。需要定量 lower margin |D(t0)|、Lipschitz bound 和低高度逼近。

construction_ideas.idea: 极端 slope 能推纯类型，前提是 projection 同时保持第二种结构。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: weakly admissible filtered Frobenius module 的 Hodge indices 仅 0,1；idempotent p 与 Frobenius 可交换且保持 filtration，1−p 也如此；p-image 的所有 slopes 同为 t∈{0,1}。
construction_ideas.mechanism: p 与 complement 分裂总对象，二者均 tH≤tN，而总和相等，故各自相等；于是 dim F1 为0或全维。原文给不保 filtration 的 slope projector 反例，说明不能仅凭 spectrum 作结论。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 在 analytic smallness 与 arithmetic rank 比较中，若用 spectral projector/column block 缩减矩阵，需证明它也保整数格或有理分母结构。可把‘同时保持两种结构的 projector’列为 rank reduction 的必要核对项。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 这不是关于整数 minors 的直接定理；保持 rational subspace 不等于低分母，必须另有 lattice-index 控制。

title: Removable Boundaries and Rigidity of Circle Domains

construction_ideas.idea: 有限阶段保留严格 margin，新增约束时不破坏先前非零证书。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 每个 stage 只有有限 tests；旧坐标可在 uniform norm 与 gradient L2 norm 中任意小改变；每个 saved barrier 具有 exact 1/0 plateau 的正距离 margins 及 strict energy slack。对 smooth Phi，误差由 M1||grad(A'−A)||2+M2||A'−A||∞||grad A||2 控制。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 为第 k 证书选 tolerance tk>0，后续第 n 阶段误差≤2^{-n-3}min(1,epsilon,t1,...,t_{n−1})/sqrt2，故所有旧证书在后续有限阶段持续成立；只需有限-list models，不假设无限-list model。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 构造逐渐扩大 row/column 的 determinant family 时，可给每个已有非零 minor 一个明确 margin 与 perturbation tolerance，并以可求和 errors 加入新 signature constraints，避免每次重选都丢掉旧 nonvanishing。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 整数/有理 rows 的 allowed perturbations 不是任意实 perturbations；应另给 rounding denominator 和 height 预算。分析 norm margin 也不等于 arithmetic lattice margin。

construction_ideas.idea: 把一个持续存在的几何障碍转为同一预算的固定正下界。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: nondegenerate compact component K 有某轴投影含长度 |J|>0；每个 barrier Vnk 为 continuous global W^{1,2}，在 enclosing contour 为1，outside fixed disk DL 为0，支持直径上界2L与阶段无关；且已有能量<k^{-2}。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 对 J 中几乎每条横线，1→0 的变化在长度≤2L 内发生，Cauchy–Schwarz 给该 slice 能量≥1/(2L)，积分得 total≥|J|/(2L)，选 k 立即矛盾。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 寻找 determinant 支持/occupancy 上一个稳定的‘投影宽度’或多个强制变化通道，将其转为同一 determinant/向量的能量或最小奇异值下界，再与 column-cost 的 analytic budget 比较。这种 stable obstruction→fixed budget lower bound 结构与目标 same-determinant 矛盾吻合。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 整数 determinant 非零下界天然离散；要得到此型解析下界需一个真实可积或离散 gradient representation，且障碍宽度不能随阶段趋零。这里只是迁移设计，不是已建立的 pi lemma。

construction_ideas.idea: 让双侧上界与一个共同下界相消成非负平方和。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 同一 normalized f 与同一 disk DR，令 M=pi R²，A=∫1，B=∫|f'|²，C=∫|f'|；有 A+pi sum rj²≤M，B+pi sum sj²≤M，且 M≤C+pi sum rjsj；各 radius 为l2故cross-term可和。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 前两式相加再减两倍第三式，得到 ∫(|f'|−1)²+pi sum(rj−sj)²≤0；下界与上界用相同变量、相同 normalizations，所有 defect 必为零。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 尝试将 column costs 和 quadratic occupancy 写成两个 quadratic budgets，而 surviving transversal 给相应 bilinear lower bound；若能对完全相同的 determinant factorization 得到这种 polarization identity，可能比逐项粗估 Hadamard 更强。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 必须从实际 determinant 构造证明三个相容 inequalities。纯形式 sum-of-squares 重写不能补 nonvanishing 或提供所需 strict inequality；Q(Z) 的 combinatorial capacities 也未自然产生 rj,sj 型l2向量。

construction_ideas.idea: 平方和而非总和控制允许无限重叠的局部错误。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: balls Bj 半径 dj 内存在两两不交 Ej⊂Bj，area(Ej)≥c dj²；aj≥0，sum aj²<∞。则 ||sum (aj/dj)1_Bj||L2≤Cc||(aj)||l2。零半径 component 的 balloons 通过 sum_{i>j}Delta_i²<Delta_j²/2 构造 disjoint residual Ej。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 对非负 dual function g 用 maximal function 点态 average bound、Cauchy–Schwarz 和 Ej disjointness，最后 L2 maximal theorem；无需 balls 自身 disjoint。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 对 row/column localization errors，若每个 support 可指定一个占固定比例且彼此不交的 core，可用 square occupancy budget 综合重叠误差，而不付粗糙 overlap-count 因子。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 这是平面 L2 maximal theorem 的具体结构；离散矩阵版本需对应的 bounded maximal/averaging operator 与 core packing。没有这些结构时不能把 l1损失直接改成l2。

title: The symmetric Mahler conjecture and its equality cases

construction_ideas.idea: A global minor-mass budget can locate a nonzero feasible basis before optimizing its cost.
assumptions: The candidate row family spans the intended determinant dimension, over the field relevant to the integer determinant.
A holomorphic constraint construction can be made whose minor factors are the same candidate determinants and whose compact sublevels and isolated zero are proved.
An additional cost-weighted estimate, absent from the manuscript's ΣP_I≥1 statement, controls the total degree/height of a feasible basis.
construction_ideas.speculative_interface: For candidate row transversals Q(Z), attach strip constraints to the actual row vectors and view Σ_I P_I as a distribution of independent bases. Test a cost filtration by column degree/denominator size and seek a mass inequality concentrated below the analytic smallness threshold. This could separate proving some minor nonzero from charging its columns, but the existing lemma alone gives no cheap basis and cannot repair deficient rank.

construction_ideas.idea: A single dual feasibility witness can certify all competing row costs, including singular limits.
assumptions: The proposed determinant/column costs admit a convex positive-representation or matroid base formulation.
The same chosen witness is valid for every candidate constraint; competitors cannot each choose a different witness.
Any zero-deficit-to-pointwise upgrade uses positive-volume neighborhoods and actual compactness, rather than assuming pointwise convergence.
construction_ideas.speculative_interface: Represent a target signature or budget direction by costed candidate rows. Find a dual vector Y giving c_i·Y=cost_i on selected rows and h·Y≤cost_h on every candidate. Then every competing representation has cost at least ξ·Y. The manuscript's integrated deficit and degenerate-limit treatment suggest how to retain such a certificate when candidate bases coalesce. Apply first to a finite model of signature capacities/Q(Z), keeping this optimization certificate separate from the needed integer nonzero determinant.

title: The Unique Games Theorem

construction_ideas.idea: Use a harmonic rank potential to compare useful contraction against loss of independence.
assumptions: A concrete family of permitted row/column restrictions has rank drop at most one per step, with conditional loss probability≤c r θ at current rank r.
The rank-loss estimate holds for every extension map that earlier choices can induce; assuming independence from an adaptive construction is insufficient.
The operation improves the analytic determinant size on the same object and preserves its integer structure.
construction_ideas.speculative_interface: In a costed-column determinant construction, track H_r=Σ_{j≤r}1/j instead of raw remaining rank. If collisions among candidate Q(Z) row transversals have probability O(rθ), expected H_r loss is O(θ), permitting many smallness-improving steps while retaining positive rank with explicit probability. A finite simulation should measure rank loss conditioned on signature occupancy, then test whether candidate selection obeys a uniform extension-map bound.

construction_ideas.idea: Prove genericity uniformly over adversarial coefficients using an augmented nonzero minor.
assumptions: The evaluation vectors have algebraic parameter dependence and an algebraic obstruction to column-span membership.
A nonzero polynomial minor is established symbolically before specializing parameters.
Finite-field genericity must be replaced or lifted with explicit integer heights and rational-approximation errors for the actual π problem.
construction_ideas.speculative_interface: The latent proof handles all maps g simultaneously by showing a nonlinear target evaluation vector is outside a matrix column span, then exhibits one augmented minor as a nonzero bounded-degree polynomial. For quadratic occupancy/signature constraints, formulate potential zero terms as target-in-span conditions; prove a formal augmented minor nonzero via monomial/parity support, then specialize integer parameters away from its zero set while costing the specialization. This is a route to certify that structural zero terms do not consume every candidate, rather than counting signatures alone.

construction_ideas.idea: Keep nonlinear stability and linear detection as separately quantified requirements.
assumptions: The two properties are verified under the exact same noise or perturbation law.
Nonlinear error probability and linear detection threshold are fixed before ambient dimension/number of columns grows.
Any lifting to rational approximation controls denominator growth from products and quotients.
construction_ideas.speculative_interface: Treat the analytic smallness of an integral or Padé-type column as the stable nonlinear observable, and determinant rank as detection by a linear family. Search for a perturbation of row choices that changes analytic errors rarely but is detected by any large annihilator/signature space. The manuscript shows that these goals can coexist abstractly; it does not construct such a perturbation for π.

construction_ideas.idea: Use a sparse perturbation regime with many useful coordinates but asymptotically unchanged full law.
assumptions: Independent block contributions have a bounded chi-squared divergence between the ordinary and special-coordinate laws.
The ambient alphabet and all local dimensions are fixed before the number k of blocks grows.
A nonzero determinant or capacity event is transferred using the joint table distribution; agreement of separate marginals is insufficient.
construction_ideas.speculative_interface: For candidate row transversals Q(Z), design a mixture that marks a coordinate with probability β. A full-law bound of order kβ² can vanish while kβ diverges, giving many special rows under nearly the same candidate distribution. β=k^(−2/3) balances these requirements. This is directly relevant to quadratic occupancy: a proposed capacity improvement should be checked under the actual joint row law and include the cost of conditioning on distinct/signature-safe selections. It remains speculative until the local likelihood ratio and determinant nonvanishing event are established.

title: Uniform bounds for planar polynomial limit cycles

construction_ideas.idea: Protect zero-term analysis by an exact scale flag and distinguish zero germs from cancellation on a sequence.
assumptions: Every determinant contribution/error term can be expressed in a finite ordered collection of actual scales, with exact dependencies and bounded ordinary backgrounds.
After cancellation, an asserted leading coefficient is a nonzero analytic germ, not merely nonzero at selected sample points.
Any claim that all asymptotic terms vanishing implies exact zero requires a proved domain/separation theorem; real flatness alone is inadequate.
construction_ideas.speculative_interface: For Δ_N(q,p) built from costed columns near p/q≈π, encode factorial, exponential and powers of q scales in a flag and reduce exact dependencies before ordering determinant terms. Label the zero-term loss by the first genuinely nonzero signature coefficient. Preserve free approximation scale variables when inserting −log|qπ−p|. This could expose where quadratic occupancy arguments count only formally distinct terms that actually cancel.

construction_ideas.idea: Use finite-request safe intervals to avoid all finitely many bad denominator or pole lattices without asserting equidistribution.
assumptions: Relevant sweeps are eventually increasing with derivatives tending to infinity and |x''/(x')²|≤C/x.
Only a fixed finite list of bad lattices is excluded at a given determinant size.
The application needs continuous parameter choices or a separate integer-point argument; safe real columns do not automatically supply integer N/q.
construction_ideas.speculative_interface: When coefficient transformations create finitely many sine, gamma or reciprocal factors, select a common detuned parameter interval by bounding time spent near each bad lattice and union bounding; no independence or incommensurability of sweeps is needed. Then separately prove an allowed integer index exists in that interval and charge the interval width. This could stabilize candidate-row transversals near singular factors but is not itself a Diophantine approximation theorem.

construction_ideas.idea: Maintain explicit buffers and fixed derivative-loss exponents before strengthening accuracy.
assumptions: The analytic upper bound can be continued to complex domains with quantitative buffers, not just real estimates.
Only finitely many derivative/coherence orders are needed per determinant and all cost exponents are fixed before accuracy is increased.
Dependent scales are reevaluated at current background values after implicit changes.
construction_ideas.speculative_interface: For a near-vanishing determinant perturbation or parameter correction, write a ledger of analytic decay versus derivative and denominator losses. Reserve a positive buffer that survives the row/column transformations. The flags proof's hierarchy and high finite-jet sensitivity suggest a disciplined way to prevent a later approximation accuracy requirement from silently increasing the column-degree budget past the small-integer threshold.

construction_ideas.idea: Combine colliding terms exactly before separating costs or taking absolute values.
assumptions: A finite cluster identity is proved at coinciding exponents or signatures, with its removable singularities retained.
Every clustered coefficient is added using exact algebra before calling it nonzero or estimating its size.
The same clustered object remains an integer after denominator clearing; this must be checked separately.
construction_ideas.speculative_interface: The mixed-passage proof keeps the analytic residue cluster (exp(−C0 L)−exp(−C1 L))/(C1−C0), whose equal-cost limit is L exp(−C0 L), instead of treating two singular residue terms separately. In the determinant expansion for π, group row transversals with the same signature/exponent before capacity counting. A signature may have many combinatorial occupants but a zero total coefficient. Conversely near collisions may contribute polynomial prefactors rather than independent exponential terms. Derive an exact cluster formula first, then cost its polynomial factor in the analytic smallness ledger.

construction_ideas.idea: Use an exact multiscale leading-coefficient certificate for surviving determinant terms, and keep formal rank separate from analytic separation.
construction_ideas.source_mechanism: Zero-subtree suppression and finite leading-prefix isolation in section 03; exact current-symbol bookkeeping and cleaned positive trees in section 04.
construction_ideas.project_interface: For a proposed integer determinant Delta_N built from costed columns and candidate row transversals over Q(Z), expand the exact determinant into signature coefficients before taking absolute values. Put its genuinely occurring scales into a finite lexicographic flag, reduce exact dependencies, and exhibit a first nonzero coefficient by a symbolic minor/wedge or an explicit uncancelled monomial. Record its row-rank certificate and the same selected columns. Only then use scale domination to compare all later signatures and numerical errors. A tree is useful when an infinite lexicographic initial segment would make a flat truncation misleading: work at successive prefixes and pass only finitely many siblings for each requested budget.
assumptions: Actual determinant terms admit an exact finite or iterated left-finite multiscale expansion with controlled coefficients.
The leading coefficient is proved nonzero over Q(Z) using permitted rows, signature caps and integer normalizations; it must not be inferred merely from formal distinctness.
If infinite asymptotic tails are used, a relevant separation theorem with complex-domain/source hypotheses is independently proved; numerical smallness to all real orders does not suffice.
construction_ideas.required_bridge: Prove an explicit project-specific nonzero minor and surviving coefficient, a controlled integer specialization, and a bound for that exact determinant. The manuscript supplies no arithmetic rank theorem and no pi approximation estimate.
construction_ideas.expected_value: A way to isolate where cancellation destroys all purported surviving transversals, while preventing a rank argument for one matrix from being combined with a smallness bound for another.

construction_ideas.idea: Fix the structural determinant cost and conditioning exponents before asking for higher cancellation accuracy.
construction_ideas.source_mechanism: Common domains and deferred-floor elimination in section 05, especially the fixed chronology/prefix invariant and complete Schur feedback formulas.
construction_ideas.project_interface: Design a finite row/column construction with a frozen chronological list of permitted operations, a symbolic rank witness, signature-cap ledger and explicit denominator/height generators. Compute the actual forward/inverse losses and column cost, including quadratic occupancy, on this fixed structure. Then test whether cancellation/approximation order can increase by refining coefficient formulas only, leaving those structural exponents fixed. If yes, select accuracy last so the analytic determinant upper bound beats all fixed losses and falls below 1, while an independently certified nonzero integer determinant has absolute value at least 1. Any parameter correction must use the full derivative including induced record/coefficient feedback, and preserve a power-sized available neighborhood.
assumptions: Increasing accuracy does not add columns/rows, enlarge signature capacities, increase quadratic occupancy exponents or change the selected rank certificate.
All row operations are unimodular or their exact integer scaling/denominators are included in the same cost ledger.

The refined actual maps/coefficients have uniform power-domain and derivative bounds; a finite formula having larger denominator multiplicities is harmless only if an actual-map comparison proves the uniform bounds.
construction_ideas.required_bridge: Exhibit a concrete arbitrary-accuracy cancellation mechanism with cost exponent independent of its accuracy, and show it acts on the same integer minor. title: Eventual categoricity for abstract elementary classes

construction_ideas.idea: Count only genuinely new support events when turning coherent local realizations into a global placement.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: A fixed finite-support template with natural diagrams; at most sigma new support positions; disjoint block transpositions preserve diagrams; every coherent prescription on a parameter set of size at most chi is locally realizable; chi^sigma=chi and chi dominates the fixed language and arities. The non-well-ordered version additionally needs all bounded local prescriptions and closure under the entire sigma+-stage profile-growth recursion.
construction_ideas.mechanism: Over each current parameter set, consider all support profiles and one failed query per no-new-event continuation. A final local realization must incur a new old-position hit or a new separation of two new positions at every stage. There are at most sigma such first events, contradicting sigma+ stages. The conclusion preserves complete joint diagrams, including equalities, rather than just separate finite tests.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Speculative interface to the pi project: maintain a finite ledger of row-signature hits, row/column identifications, and separations while refining a candidate common-basis family for Q(Z). If all failures can be charged to first events and local prescriptions are jointly feasible, an adaptive search might terminate with one globally compatible row selection. This is a combinatorial candidate-selection principle, not a determinant estimate.
construction_ideas.missing_step: One must prove that the actual rational row-rank/common-basis constraints admit the required coherent local realizations and that no-event moves preserve the same formal minor. The source does not control integer specialization height, common denominator, column cost, quadratic occupancy, or the nonzero and small bounds for one normalized integer determinant.

construction_ideas.idea: Separate a small object that supplies exact alignment from a larger reservoir that pays for enumerating all its constraints.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: The source has a fixed palette of theta-tuple support records and named strong-map profiles, categoricity at repeated sizes a<mu, a^theta<=mu, large cofinality of the ambient index orders, and an aligned a-sized subpresentation computing every theta-tuple record exactly. Strong unions, coherence, and persistence of inability to reach an orbit are essential.
construction_ideas.mechanism: Repeat profiles at two sizes. During theta+ rounds enumerate all a^theta tuples of the small model in the larger model, push every tuple that can reach a forbidden orbit onward to an irreversible orbit, and retain aligned small submodels. Their small union still realizes the forbidden orbit by categoricity, contradicting the persistent elimination. No closure a^theta=a or mu^theta=mu is needed.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Speculative interface: distinguish a compact signature/core object used to certify rank from a larger auxiliary sampling or interpolation reservoir used to process many basis constraints. The larger reservoir can absorb enumeration without demanding an unrealistic self-reproduction property of the final determinant size.
construction_ideas.missing_step: For pi, the palette would have to include exact formal-rank information, the literal chosen row/column map, and arithmetic normalization. A repeated coarse occupancy profile need not determine a nonzero minor. Reservoir size can itself destroy the height/cost inequality, so this architecture offers no quantitative gain until both resources are budgeted.

construction_ideas.idea: Replace ambient-size-dependent obstruction searches by a set of monotone ordinal-vector witnesses.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: The coordinates form one fixed set C. Valid configurations are uniformly set-theoretically definable using fixed set parameters. Their variable portions are ordinal lengths of well-ordered slots, and coordinatewise domination between valid configurations gives an embedding preserving designated terms and natural comparisons. For rational tilings, freeze every exceptional countable fiber hit or split by bounded candidate supports, the initial order, and all support comparisons first.
construction_ideas.mechanism: If no set of witnesses generates the class upward, choose a sufficiently long sequence of vectors each dominating none of the earlier ones. Color each pair by a coordinate that decreases; the partition argument produces an infinite descending ordinal sequence. Bounding the sizes of a set of valid unequal witnesses yields a parameter-test bound independent of the ambient base size.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Speculative interface: encode ordered column blocks or multiplicity capacities by a fixed vector of lengths and seek a finite or explicitly bounded set of minimal rank/compatibility obstructions. The finite-coordinate analogue suggests a Dickson-style organization of obstruction search and could separate support shape from ambient multiplicity.
construction_ideas.missing_step: The determinant constraints must actually be monotone under the chosen embeddings. Adding columns or changing multiplicities can change cancellations, common bases, and cost, so monotonicity is not automatic. The paper supplies existential set bounds, not computable generators or low-height witnesses; a useful pi application requires explicit quantitative bounds.

construction_ideas.idea: Use two different approximation lengths to justify interchanging majority evaluations.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: For each bounded query, approximation families have a uniform exception bound e on the relevant row/column comparisons, independent of the lengths of the families. In the source e is an infinite cardinal, kappa=e+ and lambda=kappa+ lie below the eligible level, and diagrams are preserved when queries move over the full bounded code sequences.
construction_ideas.mechanism: For the comparison array, all but at most e rows have one majority S, with at most e exceptional columns per good row. Their union has size at most kappa*e=kappa. Choose a column among lambda>kappa outside this union and the bad-column set; its column majority R and more than e good-row entries force R=S. Equal sequence lengths would not support this argument.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Speculative interface: if several row-rank or specialization tests each fail on a controlled set of parameter values, deliberately choose unequal sampling budgets so that one sample survives their combined exceptions. A finite implementation needs explicit uniform failure counts and can be audited as a common-witness selection argument.
construction_ideas.missing_step: Neither a cardinal majority argument nor typical full rank controls coefficients or proves that the same integer determinant is small. For pi one still needs actual finite root/failure bounds, an admissible specialization range, denominator clearance, and the column/occupancy cost of the common surviving choice.

construction_ideas.idea: Descend whole bounded configurations using one family of pointwise almost-identity maps, even when the configuration spans a limit construction.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: Same-level working objects A<=U admit arrows r_i:U->A such that each a in A is fixed by all but finitely many indices. Smaller compatible sections A-prime<=U-prime must be closed under all selected retraction images. The query size, majority sequence, diagram tests, and approximation costs must remain strictly below the smaller eligible level.
construction_ideas.mechanism: For a bounded query Z, all but at most |Z|+aleph0 maps fix Z pointwise. Hence (r_i(d)) computes the actual type of d over A by majority, and the average-descent theorem identifies it with the free lift of the smaller type over A-prime. This handles every bounded d separately without assuming it appears in one stage of a countable exhaustion.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Speculative interface: construct variable substitutions or support-deletion maps that preserve a rank witness while fixing each relevant coefficient/test outside a controlled exceptional set. Close a smaller coefficient/support model under their images before descending a joint row configuration.
construction_ideas.missing_step: Arbitrary specialization or deletion maps do not preserve formal rank and are not literal retractions on the required determinant. A finite arithmetic version needs uniform exception counts, injectivity on chosen witnesses, and exact compatibility with a common denominator and normalization. The source gives no analytic smallness estimate.

construction_ideas.idea: Retain boundary compatibility as the shared invariant while postponing incompatible full realizations.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: Finite system schemes have a proved working package, exact projection/type correspondence, uniform parameter-orbit bounds, and completion in lower dimensions. Full coherent arrows are retained on each branch, but only compatible boundary maps are retained in the common accumulator.
construction_ideas.mechanism: A return tree amplifies an alleged boundary disagreement to more than chi distinguishable leaf images over at most chi shared tests. A separate argument is still needed for onto lifting to the prescribed target.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Speculative interface: in a divide-and-conquer search for compatible row common bases, share exact boundary signatures and overlap identifications while allowing different full interior bases in different branches. This could make a search certificate more precise about which row equalities and column occupancies are genuinely shared.
construction_ideas.missing_step: The finite row/basis problem has no established analogue of lower-dimensional completion or the source orbit bound. Compatible marginal data do not themselves imply a common full basis or preservation of the determinant minor. A usable bridge must prove those extension properties and account for quadratic occupancy across faces.

construction_ideas.idea: Add one dimension to remember an old full map while performing an induction on a different size parameter.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: Exact boundary lifting is already available at one common uniform level for every finite admissible shape. Coherent unions handle singular as well as regular limits.

The source bounded-rank-cost argument also suggests tracking added coordinate rank independently of ambient model size.
construction_ideas.missing_step: A matrix analogue needs a proved exact extension theorem for these enriched states. General common-basis systems need not have the required gluing property; preserving rank does not bound column cost or quadratic occupancy. The source finite-rank-cost result is qualitative and does not provide the constants needed for the pi determinant contradiction.

construction_ideas.source_construction: Identify affine/Killing adjoint kernels; remove their moments with a fixed positive-definite Gram matrix of smooth bumps; apply support-preserving divergence inverses to the exact moment-free source. Matched ADM translation charges make residual moments o(R^-1), while nonlinear terms are O(R^-2beta), 2beta>1.
construction_ideas.possible_interface: For a proposed rational-approximation construction, explicitly list finite algebraic obstruction functionals and choose a common family of correction vectors before estimating the analytic remainder.
construction_ideas.required_premises: Exact obstruction identities; a common basis over Q or an explicitly controlled integer lattice; nonvanishing minors and uniform denominator/conditioning bounds for every parameter used.
construction_ideas.missing_bridge: The paper uses real smooth bump functions and real positive-definite Gram matrices. It proves no integral correction mechanism, no row-rank theorem over Q(Z), and no nonzero integer determinant involving pi. Pointwise rank or real positivity cannot supply those missing arithmetic statements.
construction_ideas.status: conditional construction interface; no established transfer to pi

construction_ideas.mechanism: Arrange an exact transport identity before comparing quantities containing uncontrolled second derivatives.
construction_ideas.source_construction: Solve a Jacobi endpoint problem and prescribe a local unit vector field so the endpoint map has differential exactly equal to parallel transport, with its second derivative O(z). Pulling back a support then cancels its entire unbounded Hessian contribution and leaves an additive Cz error.
construction_ideas.possible_interface: In the integer-determinant strategy, identify the exact same determinant in the arithmetic nonvanishing statement and the analytic smallness estimate before using any approximation.
construction_ideas.required_premises: A literal algebraic identity in one common basis and normalization, with all denominator clearing recorded; the analytic estimate must bound that very integer.
construction_ideas.missing_bridge: There is no arithmetic determinant or pi-dependent map here. A near-identity comparison would leave an error multiplied by an uncontrolled determinant/Hessian analogue; the source does not remove that arithmetic obstacle.

construction_ideas.mechanism: Separate polynomial parameter losses from arbitrary fixed-parameter regularity constants.
construction_ideas.source_construction: Complete the quadratic form into nonnegative squares with coefficients bounded below by reciprocal polynomials in n. Use ell=exp(-epsilon*n), tau=ell^(3/2); first absorb polynomial boundary losses using tau/ell, then apply fixed-n Schauder/Moser bounds. Final flux loss is poly(n)*(ell+ell^2/tau), which tends to zero.
construction_ideas.possible_interface: Audit growth of every denominator, minor, occupancy bound, and error in a prospective pi approximation family. Exponential smallness can defeat proved polynomial losses when the arithmetic object is unchanged.
construction_ideas.required_premises: Uniform explicit growth bounds in the same family parameter, including all basis changes and denominator clearings; a nonzero integral witness independent of the analytic limiting procedure.
construction_ideas.missing_bridge: The arbitrary C(n) regularity constants are deliberately excluded from the final small-loss estimate. No polynomial bound for a candidate arithmetic construction follows from this paper, and quadratic occupancy alone gives neither row-rank nor a determinant lower bound.

construction_ideas.mechanism: Fix the competitor class and localize all minimizers before passing an infimum to the limit.
construction_ideas.source_construction: Use filled full obstacle perimeter, counting boundary-coincident pieces; uniform geometry and a fixed compact competitor force all minimizers into one compact set. Local uniform convergence then controls both liminf and limsup. In the many-end bridge only a directionally correct inequality between distinct competitor classes is used.
construction_ideas.possible_interface: Keep one common family of rational/integer candidates and one definition of the witness while varying auxiliary bases or parameters; prove the direction of every comparison instead of silently identifying different infima.
construction_ideas.required_premises: A parameter-independent admissible arithmetic class or proved inclusions; compactness/tightness appropriate to integer height and exact rank; preservation of the target witness.
construction_ideas.missing_bridge: Geometric perimeter compactness is not compactness of integral bases, and real metric convergence does not preserve nonzero lattice minors. No common-basis or row-rank-over-Q(Z) conclusion is supplied.

construction_ideas.mechanism: Prove the scalar solution map on the entire bounded input domain before applying degree on an admissible subset.
construction_ideas.source_construction: The implicit variable t is defined globally without a floor. A logarithmic two-point modulus uses radial ellipticity chi>=c/(1+sigma) to solve the scalar Dirichlet equation for every bounded Z input. Only then is a compact coupled map defined; a moving open admissible set excludes floor and norm boundary fixed points, and its terminal map is zero with degree one.
construction_ideas.possible_interface: If an auxiliary construction for pi is defined only for putatively good candidates, first build it on a genuine common parameter domain and prove boundary exclusions using independent estimates.
construction_ideas.required_premises: A well-defined continuous map on a common domain, compactness/degree hypotheses, and a rigorous arithmetic interpretation of its output.
construction_ideas.missing_bridge: Degree produces a real PDE solution; it neither produces rational/integer data nor establishes the desired integer determinant. No such parameter domain or arithmetic output for pi has been identified.

construction_ideas.mechanism: Keep numerical deformation and equality/nonvanishing recovery logically separate.

Equality is not transported backward through the numerical deformations.

construction_ideas.idea: Preserve the observable exactly while eliminating only a direction proved invisible to it.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: Two closed flux forms with a fixed total charge vector, a constant SO(2) rotation, and a pointwise graph-norm square completion. The intended observable is the total charge across the full enclosing cut, not separate charges on every component.
construction_ideas.mechanism: Rotate total charges to (Q,0), keep the first rotated form and discard the second zero-total-charge form, then inverse-rotate. Both original total charges and closedness survive exactly, while the discarded square is nonnegative. This is sufficient for the Riemannian comparison and does not preserve all local fields or component charges.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Speculative interface: compress row/column data only after proving the discarded directions lie in the kernel of the actual determinant/coefficient observable. Distinguish preservation of one full common constraint from preservation of each marginal component. Track the positive form under the same transformation.
construction_ideas.missing_step: A real orthogonal rotation generally destroys integer lattices and coefficient heights. A common integer determinant need not factor through a total-charge-like linear observable. A usable analogue requires rational or unimodular maps, an exact factorization identity, and explicit denominator and occupancy costs.

construction_ideas.idea: Keep error estimates uniform only in parameters that are actually sent to infinity at that stage.

construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Speculative interface: record separately polynomial losses in rank/differentiation and arbitrary constants attached to a fixed configuration. A determinant contradiction needs a final smallness estimate in which only controlled losses occur; avoid accidentally inserting a fixed-n existence bound into a growing-n asymptotic.
construction_ideas.missing_step: The project has not proved a comparable arithmetic flux/trace estimate independent of all uncontrolled constants. An exponential symbol is useful only with justified parameter order and a preserved same integer witness. No source PDE existence theorem supplies that arithmetic estimate.

construction_ideas.idea: Compare whole admissible competitor classes directly, so neither infimum attainment nor a geometric limiting object is required.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: A chosen end, full smooth enclosing cuts with coincident obstacle frontier counted, finitely many ends, conserved flux and the monotone branch r>=|Q|.

Every retained one-ended full cut is also a designated-end cut of the original manifold, so a_R>=a0 directly. Monotonicity of (r+Q²/r)/2 on the stated branch transfers the bound without taking the tail radii to infinity.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Speculative interface: prove inclusion of actual feasible common-basis/minor certificate sets under a reduction before comparing optimal full costs. A direct set comparison can avoid relying on a limit or relaxed optimum being attained by an integer configuration.
construction_ideas.missing_step: Deleting supports can remove every full-rank common basis. Inclusion and witness preservation must be proved for the real candidate sets, and the quadratic occupancy objective must be monotone in the appropriate direction. Separate per-block optima cannot replace one common optimum.

construction_ideas.idea: Use an exact first-order identification so an uncontrolled higher-order quantity never enters the error.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: A compact closed set has the expansion inequality for every smooth exterior support; smooth background metric and tensor have uniform compact-neighborhood bounds; offset distance z is below the injectivity scale. No support-curvature bound is assumed.
construction_ideas.mechanism: Solve the Jacobi two-endpoint problem J_X(0)=X, J_X(z)=P_zX. It gives a unit field and a local map F_z with dF_z(x)=P_z exactly and |∇dF_z(x)|=O(z). The Hessian chain rule then contracts the unknown support Hessian with precisely the same tangent metric at both contacts, leaving only O(z) background errors. Approximate metric alignment would multiply the uncontrolled Hessian.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Conditional arithmetic interface: seek an exact rational or unimodular coordinate identity preserving the very same integer determinant. Align all row blocks and the one selected common basis exactly before estimating residual coefficients; this may prevent a height perturbation from multiplying an uncontrolled occupancy or derivative term.
construction_ideas.missing_step: No such arithmetic transport is constructed. Real parallel transport need not preserve lattices, integer determinants, column heights or nonadditive quadratic occupancy. Required: exact row rank over Q(Z), one common basis, explicit lattice/denominator and full-cost control, and analytic smallness for that same nonzero integer witness. Separate small minors or separate block bases are insufficient.

construction_ideas.idea: Cancel a rough coefficient structurally before estimating derivatives or asymptotic size.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: In four dimensions A_z=I−(1−χ̃)e_z⊗e_z has three transverse eigenvalues exactly one and axial eigenvalue χ̃≥χ0>0; e_z is the gradient direction, gradient and scalar source G are bounded, background is smooth. χ̃ and G may be merely measurable.
construction_ideas.mechanism: A_z∇(|P|²/2)−GP=(H_z−Δz g)P cancels the measurable axial factor. Divergence cancels third derivatives and yields |H_z|²−(Δz)²+Ric(P,P), coercive up to C|G|². A rank-one Frobenius defect below one gives L² absorption and some p0>2. Gradient-drop/affine alternatives and a fixed-axis correction produce Hölder gradient and Hessian Morrey bounds without derivatives of χ̃ or G.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Conditional construction search: find an exact syzygy or antisymmetrized combination of candidate rows eliminating an uncontrolled scale-dependent coefficient before estimating it. If all blocks share one rational basis and the residual unknown direction has a quantified coercive gap, an analytic residual bound might avoid a modulus or derivative bound for that coefficient.
construction_ideas.missing_step: The PDE axial decomposition does not establish rational row independence. Needed: an explicit exact row identity in Q(Z), a common basis, a quantitative arithmetic coercive gap, and complete transformed column-height plus quadratic occupancy cost. No regularity of an unspecified π-dependent coefficient may be assumed. Cancellation alone does not force the same integer determinant below one.

construction_ideas.idea: Separate existence constants from the final asymptotic budget and avoid using the sharp estimate circularly to obtain admissibility.

Later height separation permits strict-slack absorption in the final scalar identity. Final energy error uses only Π_n(ℓ+ℓ²/η_n)→0; arbitrary fixed-n existence/Schauder constants never enter it. No limiting metric as n→∞ is required.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Conditional arithmetic workflow: establish an admissible family and a common nonzero integer witness using coarse exact information first. Then derive sharp analytic determinant smallness with a dependency graph tracking rank, derivative order, transformed column heights and the full nonadditive occupancy objective. Only controlled losses may enter the growing-parameter limit.

A formal exponential factor cannot dominate an arbitrary hidden constant depending on the same growing parameter. The π target still needs actual common witnesses, certified nonvanishing, controlled full cost and a smallness bound in the stated order of limits.

construction_ideas.idea: Compare every full feasible object under one proper map without requiring attainment of an infimum.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: The rest-end replacement agrees with original data in a growing core, has a fixed positive metric lower bound remotely, and admits a proper radial compression fixing the compact boundary. Every cut counts the entire intrinsic frontier, including disconnected and coincident pieces.

Taking infima directly gives A*(g_R)≥(1−o(1))A*(g), without compactness or attainment of a minimizing sequence.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Conditional common-basis comparison: map every feasible full-rank configuration to an admissible comparison configuration and prove a single inequality for its complete column-height plus quadratic occupancy cost. This could avoid replacing a common integer configuration with a relaxed optimum or independently minimized block costs.

A valid arithmetic map must preserve the actual common witness, row rank over Q(Z), integer nonvanishing and the full cost with explicit constants. A proper geometric map provides none of these algebraic facts automatically.

construction_ideas.idea: Classify the full null space of a nonnegative quadratic deficit before testing its first surviving higher-order term.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: A continuous nonnegative rotation-invariant quadratic form on the full real TT seed space; finite-angular approximations preserving TT and the closed kernel; a sharp TT boundary square; actual controlled expansions for a given branch.

The degree-one directions are genuine null directions even with mixed seeds meeting the boundary sign. They cannot be discarded by the sign assumption. A fourth-order square and a local tangency obstruction force c4>0 for every nonradial null direction; radial seeds instead have an exact conserved-mass identity.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Speculative interface: if a determinant-cost deficit has a nonnegative leading form, identify every degenerate family and expand the SAME certificate on that family to its first surviving order. Separate exact symmetry/equality families from obstructed directions. This may be more effective than seeking a uniform positive quadratic gap.

A zero quadratic coefficient does not by itself imply a finite-dimensional kernel or positivity at fourth order. Expansions must preserve exact rank, integer normalization and full occupancy, with usable remainder estimates.

construction_ideas.idea: Convert a boundary/asymptotic observable to a bounded exact integral functional before passing to approximation or Taylor limits.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: Each actual member has the stated C^{2,α}_τ decay with τ>3/2 and finite mass flux. The chosen weight β satisfies 3/2<β<min(τ,√3). The Green identity is first taken at fixed member; source products have weight2β and the functional is bounded in the three stated norms.

Uniform weighted function/source/boundary remainders then yield actual mass expansions without asserting uniform convergence of discarded derivative flux errors. Finite angular coefficients are also identified with their own flux before taking angular approximation limits.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Speculative interface: for determinant evaluation, seek an exact coefficient/integral representation continuous in norms whose approximation errors are controlled. Keep evaluation at the actual π parameter and integer normalization in the identity before taking asymptotic limits.
construction_ideas.missing_step: The arithmetic determinant observable and its normalization are not represented by the source Green operator. Uniform functional bounds must be proved for the actual row space and increasing dimension; a fixed-dimension continuity assertion gives no needed height bound.

construction_ideas.idea: Eliminate auxiliary local generators to obtain a global obstruction even when the generators do not agree on overlaps.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: Equality in a positive quartic integral forces mean-free lapse and tracefree second form to vanish through second order. Round-jet decomposition yields local Lie-derivative-plus-trace representatives on every compact radial interval. A separated decaying degree-one mode solves a fixed homogeneous ODE.

The remaining identity (V′−NV/r)²=6m0 V²/r³ holds globally independently of choices. For z=V/r, its integrable relative derivative bound and decay at infinity force z≡0 by backward Gronwall.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Speculative interface: use exact elimination of local row-reduction choices to find an invariant polynomial identity for a putative extremizer, avoiding unjustified global gluing of locally selected bases. Combine the invariant with a genuine boundary/asymptotic restriction.

construction_ideas.idea: Averaging certificates can be made rigid only after proving that their potentially cancelling observable is literally the same function on overlaps.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: Filled perimeter competitors form a union/intersection-closed class; submodularity and smooth interior regularity force every active minimizing cut to have the same tangent plane at meetings. Normal-slice tests annihilate a signed aggregate trace. Partial-coincidence outermostness excludes cuts retaining some original boundary components while adding others.

The signed identity Fβ=0 for positive aggregate area β therefore forces F=0 almost everywhere, then on each selected smooth cut. Contact regularity makes the whole cut a smooth MOTS, and the stronger outermostness hypothesis concentrates the multiplier on the entire original boundary.

Distinct minors or bases can cancel signed observables. A common invariant must be proved, not inferred from nonnegative mixing weights.

A finite arithmetic analogue must prove overlap compatibility and preserve the exact integer witness and quadratic occupancy costs.

construction_ideas.idea: Keep the active set, its behavior at infinity, and multiplier normalization inside one separator argument.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: A compact active-test space including an endpoint at infinity; one strict conformal direction positive on every active constraint and boundary test; a compact active-cut space with a justified one-sided envelope derivative; genuine nonlinear feasible paths from positive first variations.
construction_ideas.mechanism: A Hahn–Banach separator yields positive measures on constraints,boundary and active cuts plus a possible endpoint mass. Positivity of the strict direction forces nonzero objective mass, allowing probability normalization. Independent ADM flux prototypes then determine the asymptotic adjoint constants; free second boundary jets remove boundary atoms. Existence of a multiplier is not silently equated with its correct normalization.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Speculative interface: formulate a finite dual certificate for joint rank/height/occupancy optimization which includes every active constraint and recession direction. Prove objective multiplier nonzero with a common strict feasible direction, and test independent normalizations before drawing a contradiction.

A real separating measure need not select a usable integer configuration or control denominators. The source proves no arithmetic strong duality.

construction_ideas.idea: Treat degeneracy as a separate region and remove it with weighted logarithmic energy before applying rigidity.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: A smooth nonnegative Killing norm N, u>0, a semidefinite inverse base tensor C whose degeneracy is controlled by N, exact norm/twist divergence identities, and complete regular base attachments. No regularity or measure-zero assumption on the internal set N=0.

In shrinking bands ε<N<2ε the exact twist-flux contraction is orthogonal to X; errors are dominated by an integrable function and vanish even if the zero set has positive measure. Static base completeness and a conformal double then exclude remaining internal-null ends. Causality alone had allowed aligned null dust and was not called vacuum prematurely.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Speculative interface: distinguish formal rank-deficient boundary strata from the full-rank region, and seek exact weighted identities plus an integrable error bound that permit removing neighborhoods without assuming genericity covers the desired witness. Preserve the degeneration scale in all estimates.

Integer singularities and height blow-up need separate explicit control; geometric removability gives no arithmetic result.

construction_ideas.idea: Retain every tied optimizer before extracting a dual certificate.

A separating positive functional becomes a probability measure on the entire minimizing space, a positive active-constraint measure, and a boundary multiplier. Outermostness then identifies almost every selected frontier with the original horizon.

This can expose a silent change of optimizer between a nonvanishing argument and an analytic bound.

No compact arithmetic basis family, strict integral correction, row rank over Q(Z), or positive measure supported on integer nonzero minors is supplied. A common optimizer must still yield the very same denominator-cleared nonzero integer determinant that is analytically small; probability averaging cannot replace that witness.
construction_ideas.status: Conditional proof-design interface, not an arithmetic result.

construction_ideas.idea: Use finite-jet rigidity plus independent normalization tests to preserve the original object.
construction_ideas.required_premises: A smooth homogeneous prolonged first-order system for the field and its first jet; positivity or causality ruling out affine growth; a Hessian bound with exponent q0>1; and a finite family of independent flux probes normalized in the same frame.

Prolongation turns the first jet into a linear ODE along curves, giving one-sided boundary extension and unique determination. Causality removes the linear term in the end expansion. Five explicit end prototypes then fix the asymptotic lapse and shift from their independent energy/momentum derivatives. Recovery uses an exact metric identity, so both original g and original K are retained.

A finite list of exact tests can be an audit device if it determines the object.

Five real ADM probes do not establish full row rank over Q(Z), integral basis compatibility, or denominator bounds. Any arithmetic normalization must prove exact equality of the integer witness and explicitly control its column heights and quadratic occupancy.

construction_ideas.idea: Control a coupled singular error before removing a bad locus.

The twist-current contraction cancels its component parallel to X, leaving only d_D log N. Its cutoff cost on ε<N<2ε is bounded by the integral of 1+|d_D log N|² over that moving band and tends to zero by dominated convergence. Separate boundary-lapse expansions and q0>1 end decay remove the remaining cutoff terms. No measure or regularity of the interior null set is assumed.
construction_ideas.possible_interface: For the determinant strategy, seek an exact coupled error/occupancy identity and an integrable bound on the actual bad-configuration cost before discarding rare or high-occupancy configurations. The controlling quantity must retain cross terms and the same column-height normalization.
construction_ideas.missing_bridge: No arithmetic analogue of the current cancellation or logarithmic energy is established. Column-height control alone cannot substitute for the quadratic occupancy estimate, and separate marginal estimates need not control the coupled cost. This method does not prove an integer determinant nonzero or small, and it does not classify π as BA or non-BA.

construction_ideas.idea: Preserve one exact target flux while allowing uncontrolled auxiliary ends.
construction_ideas.required_premises: A complete scalar-flat C² space with a distinguished end, compactly supported perturbation/smoothing, uniform core estimates anchored at that end, and finite exhaustions with Dirichlet data at the chosen outer sphere and homogeneous Neumann data at every other artificial boundary.

The finite-domain divergence identity has zero flux at the auxiliary Neumann boundaries. Passing to the limit on a fixed sphere and fixed curvature support preserves the distinguished-end flux exactly; no unproved zero-flux assertion at limiting ends is used. Its positive sign would give negative mass, contradicting the cited smooth positive-mass nonnegativity theorem; Ricci flatness and volume comparison then classify the double.

A limit argument should transfer the same witness, not assume discarded terms vanish.

It supplies no integral solution or lattice-preserving correction and no common basis for Q(Z). The required nonzero determinant, analytic smallness of that same integer, and simultaneous column-height plus quadratic-occupancy estimates remain separate unproved obligations.

title: An irrational-trace counterexample to reduced Baum–Connes

construction_ideas.idea: Farthest-first elimination with one simultaneous overlap container can certify exact local relations after imposing infinitely many global relations.

build/module.tex, Lemma lem:module-intersection and equation eq:module-intersection
construction_ideas.exact_premises: Every finite participating family admits an order in which all intersections of the current block with remaining blocks lie in one designated small intrinsic ball. For cycles that ball is an induced tree; for module relations every nonzero dual codeword has support larger than the ball. All sums are finite-support algebraic sums, and the chosen root/ball works simultaneously for every earlier-or-equal-distance block.
construction_ideas.speculative_interface: For the current Q(Z) row-rank/common-basis problem, seek structured row blocks and a finite-support elimination order with an exact shared-coordinate container that cannot support a nonzero relation. This can turn local independence into an exact global rank certificate under explicit premises.
construction_ideas.missing_bridge: Pairwise small overlaps do not establish the simultaneous container. The source works over F_2 and F_p, whereas the target needs characteristic-zero rank and one integer determinant. A lift preserving exact lattice relations and height, plus a quantitative bound on that same nonzero determinant, is absent.

construction_ideas.idea: Convert overlapping local deficits to a global estimate by charging rank only to disjoint exterior resources.

After farthest-first coordinate elimination, every introduced edge outside the enabled graph lies in the induced overlap tree. An attachment pair creates a long simple cycle; girth packs its endpoints. Local invalid-copy degree deficits hold uniformly, and charged exterior vertex sets are pairwise disjoint.
construction_ideas.speculative_interface: The current column-height plus nonadditive quadratic-occupancy task could search for a rank/dimension surrogate whose successive contributions can be assigned to disjoint exterior coordinate sets, instead of adding overlapping local bounds. The exact tree-attachment identity b_1(D)=sum_C(b_1(C)+max(0,l_C-1)) illustrates how to retain an interaction correction rather than discard it.

construction_ideas.idea: Enforce one prescribed finite-pattern law with both primal and dual code distances, then separately globalize spectral isolation.
source_anchors: build/spectrum.tex, Lemmas lem:local-deficit and lem:spectral-gap; Proposition prop:projection
construction_ideas.exact_premises: A fixed full-support word belongs to a half-dimensional code; primal distance creates discrepancies and dual distance prevents additional local relations. Exact quotient intersection gives Haar marginals p^(-k_i). A uniform gap holds in every faithful evaluation representation on both valid components and their entire complement.
construction_ideas.speculative_interface: Distant construction template: combine exact local statistical constraints with a separately proved global analytic separation, keeping local law and global gap as distinct obligations. Sparse prescribed probabilities then encode a nonperiodic scalar trace.
construction_ideas.missing_bridge: The resulting scalar is an engineered sparse base-p series, not pi. It provides neither BA nor non-BA behavior of pi and no estimate on q²|pi-p/q|.
